description: Fresh implementation holdout: 12 English questions, six paired Hinglish questions and six negatives. Authored and source-reviewed without retrieval results; not human ground truth.

labels.note: Equivalent answer-bearing chunks are alternatives within a group. Quotes were checked against each named source before scoring.
